I see. The `fixup_pcap_pkthdr` is called after reading the packet data into `p->buffer`. The buffer is grown to at least `hdr->caplen` bytes. So if `caplen` is small (e.g., 1 byte), the buffer will be small, and `fixup_pcap_pkthdr` will read beyond the buffer when accessing `usb_hdr->data_flag`, `usb_hdr->ndesc`, and `usb_hdr->urb_len`.
